title: GF(2^m) batch mul/square m=8,16,32 via VPCLMULQDQ
description:
## Current

`Gf2mField::mul` and `square` in `crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/field.rs` are called per-element. No batch element-wise SIMD path even though VPCLMULQDQ-on-YMM can process two element pairs per instruction for m ≤ 32.

## Fix

Add a new `Gf2mBatchFns` set in `gf2-kernels-simd` (sibling of existing `Gf2mFns`):

- V3 SIMD: VPCLMULQDQ-on-YMM (2 element pairs / instr) + Barrett reduce in YMM. Reduction lookup table fits a YMM lane for m ≤ 32.
- V4 unroll: 4-way unroll across the dependent reduce step for ILP.

Wire dispatch via new `simd::maybe_gf2m_batch()` accessor.

## Per-kernel execution protocol (epic spec doc)

Per A1's protocol, with bench targets `gf2m_mul_strategies` (existing — already compares 5+ strategies, add new batch entry).

## Depends on

I1, I2, I3, I4.

## Success criteria

- [hard] Bit-exact vs. all existing scalar strategies for m ∈ {8, 16, 32}.
- [hard] Existing `gf2m_mul_strategies.rs` shows the new batch path on its strategy comparison table.
- [hard] No `unsafe` outside `gf2-kernels-simd`.
- [aspirational] ≥1.5× geomean over the fastest existing strategy for batches ≥ 256 elements.
